text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright. My personal rule—"Go for a walk 
until you're satisfied whenever you spot a 
cloud with a hole in it"—is cleared!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Is nobody here? But I could've 
sworn I heard someone say 
'congratulations'..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ah! Could you be... the Three Goddesses?
